sentence: This project strengthens cybersecurity research programs and the partnership between a university and government agencies.
This project brings together experts to think about how combinatorics and theoretical computer science can help each other.
This project builds an online platform that simulates climate change adaptation in local communities and tests whether it helps people learn.
This project builds quantum computing methods that solve hard optimization problems in electric power systems.
This project builds image sensors that measure the phase and polarization of light in a single shot.
This project builds deep learning models that measure the uncertainty of their predictions on time series data.
This project studies which bacteria in the insect gut break down plant toxins and how much this helps insects eat plants.
This project studies how cells interact with acoustic waves to build a sensor that measures their mechanical properties.
This project offers a course on the physics of glaciers and ice sheets, using satellite data and numerical models.
This project studies the genes behind seed filling and nutrition in edamame and mature soybeans.
This project pairs research on coastal ecosystems with research on chemical engineering to tackle coastal and energy challenges.
This project studies how pharmaceuticals and personal care products break down into byproducts in river sediments.
This project studies how bacterial enzymes and hydrogen sulfide break down azo compounds found in drugs and food dyes in the human gut.
This project designs radiofrequency pulses with artificial intelligence software to improve nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy and imaging.
This project builds tools to edit the genomes of fungi and to learn what their genes do.
This project runs a set of mobile radars and instruments that scientists use to study severe weather such as tornadoes and hurricanes.
This project builds an electrochemical biosensing platform that uses machine learning to track biomarkers such as levodopa and lactate in real time.
